dialogues.speaker: Kumari
dialogues.text: Why won't Dad let me learn to dance...?

dialogues.speaker: Kumari
dialogues.text: He said dancing was looked down upon in Sumeru. To live a better life, I should go to school instead of learning how to dance.

dialogues.speaker: Kumari
dialogues.text: B—But, Nilou is so good at dancing, and everybody loves her so much...

dialogues.speaker: Kumari
dialogues.text: Is success at school more desirable than being a good dancer?
